## August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 142)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network and public radio, two classic *A Date with Judy* teenage sitcoms for Pepsodent and Swan Soap, Gale Gordon investigating an antique mortuary on *The Casebook of Gregory Hood* for Petri Wine, Powers Boothe and Randy Quaid in James McLure's *Lone Star* on NPR *Earplay*, and two Nick & Nora Charles 15-minute serial mysteries (*The Two-Cent Panama* and *The Formal Duck*) produced by Himan Brown for Procter & Gamble (1941–1981):
